characters.name: Bart Cassidy
characters.desc_en: Each time he is hit, he draws a card.

characters.name: Black Jack
characters.desc_en: He shows the second card he draws. On Heart or Diamonds, he draws one more card.

characters.name: Calamity Janet
characters.desc_en: She can play BANG! cards as Missed! cards and vice versa.

characters.name: El Gringo
characters.desc_en: Each time he is hit by a player, he steals a card from the hand of that player.

characters.name: Jesse Jones
characters.desc_en: He may steal his first card from the hand of a player.

characters.name: Jourdonnais
characters.desc_en: Whenever he is the target of a BANG!, he may Draw!: on a Heart, he is missed.

characters.name: Kit Carlson
characters.desc_en: He looks at the top three cards of the deck and chooses the 2 to draw.

characters.name: Lucky Duke
characters.desc_en: Each time he is required to Draw!, he flips the top two cards and chooses the result.

characters.name: Paul Regret
characters.desc_en: All players see him at a distance increased by 1.

characters.name: Pedro Ramirez
characters.desc_en: He may draw his first card from the discard pile.

characters.name: Rose Doolan
characters.desc_en: She sees all players at a distance decreased by 1.

characters.name: Sid Ketchum
characters.desc_en: He may discard 2 cards to regain one life point.

characters.name: Slab the Killer
characters.desc_en: Players need 2 Missed! cards to cancel his BANG! card.

characters.name: Suzy Lafayette
characters.desc_en: As soon as she has no cards in hand, she draws a card.

characters.name: Vulture Sam
characters.desc_en: Whenever a player is eliminated from play, he takes in hand all the cards of that player.

characters.name: Willy the Kid
characters.desc_en: He can play any number of BANG! cards.

characters.name: Apache Kid
characters.desc_en: Cards of Diamonds played by other players do not affect him.

characters.name: Belle Star
characters.desc_en: During her turn, cards in play in front of other players have no effect.

characters.name: Bill Noface
characters.desc_en: He draws 1 card, plus 1 card for each wound he has.

characters.name: Chuck Wengam
characters.desc_en: During his turn, he may choose to lose 1 life point to draw 2 cards.

characters.name: Doc Holyday
characters.desc_en: During his turn, he may discard any 2 cards from the hand to shoot a BANG!

characters.name: Elena Fuente
characters.desc_en: She may use any card in her hand as a Missed!

characters.name: Greg Digger
characters.desc_en: Each time another player is eliminated, he regains 2 life points.

characters.name: Herb Hunter
characters.desc_en: Each time another player is eliminated, he draws 2 extra cards.

characters.name: Jose Delgado
characters.desc_en: Twice in his turn, he may discard a blue card from the hand to draw 2 cards.

characters.name: Molly Stark
characters.desc_en: Each time she uses a card from her hand out of turn, she draws a card.

characters.name: Pat Brennan
characters.desc_en: He may steal only one card in play in front of any one player instead of drawing during phase 1.

characters.name: Pixie Pete
characters.desc_en: He draws 3 cards instead of 2.

characters.name: Sean Mallory
characters.desc_en: He may hold in his hand up to 10 cards.

characters.name: Tequila Joe
characters.desc_en: Each time he plays a Beer, he regains 2 life points instead of 1.

characters.name: Vera Custer
characters.desc_en: For one whole round, she gains the same ability of another character in play of her choice.

roles.name: Sheriff
roles.desc_en: Kill all the Outlaws and the Renegade!

roles.name: Deputy Sheriff
roles.desc_en: Protect the Sheriff! Kill all the Outlaws and the Renegade!

roles.name: Renegade
roles.desc_en: Be the last one in play!

events.name: Blessing
events.desc_en: The suit of all cards is Hearts.

events.name: Curse
events.desc_en: The suit of all cards is Spades.

events.name: Ghost Town
events.desc_en: During their turn, eliminated players return to play as ghosts: they draw 3 cards instead of 2, cannot die, and leave play at the end of their turn.

events.name: Gold Rush
events.desc_en: The game proceeds counterclockwise, always starting from the Sheriff. All card effects proceed counterclockwise.

events.name: Hangover
events.desc_en: All characters lose their special abilities.

events.name: High Noon
events.desc_en: Each player loses 1 life point at the start of his turn.

events.name: Shootout
events.desc_en: Each player can play a second BANG! card during his turn.

events.name: The Daltons
events.desc_en: When The Daltons enter play, each player with blue cards in front of him discards one of his choice.

events.name: The Doctor
events.desc_en: When The Doctor enters play, the player(s) in play with the fewest current life points regain(s) 1 life point.

events.name: The Reverend
events.desc_en: Players cannot play any Beer cards.

events.name: The Sermon
events.desc_en: Each player cannot use BANG! cards during his turn.

events.name: Thirst
events.desc_en: Each player only draws his first card, not the second one, during phase 1 of his turn.

events.name: Train Arrival
events.desc_en: Each player draws one extra card at the end of phase 1 of his turn.

events.name: Ambush
events.desc_en: The distance between any two players is 1. This is modified only by cards in play.

events.name: Sniper
events.desc_en: During his turn, the player may discard 2 BANG! cards together against a player: this counts as a BANG!, but requires 2 Missed! to be canceled.

events.name: Dead Man
events.desc_en: During his turn, the player who was eliminated first returns to play with 2 life points and 2 cards.

events.name: Blood Brothers
events.desc_en: At the beginning of his turn, each player may lose one life point (except his last one) to give one life point to any player of his choice.

events.name: The Judge
events.desc_en: You cannot play cards in front of yourself or any other player.

events.name: Lasso
events.desc_en: Cards in play in front of players have no effect.

events.name: Law of the West
events.desc_en: During his phase 1, each player shows the second card he draws: if he can, he must play it during his phase 2.

events.name: Hard Liquor
events.desc_en: Each player may skip his phase 1 to regain 1 life point.

events.name: Abandoned Mine
events.desc_en: During his phase 1, each player draws from the discard pile and discards face up on the deck.

events.name: A Fistful of Cards
events.desc_en: At the beginning of his turn, the player is the target of as many BANG! as the number of cards in his hand.

events.name: Peyote
events.desc_en: Instead of drawing in his phase 1, each player guesses if the suit of the top card of the deck is red or black. He then draws and shows it: if he guessed right, he keeps it and may guess again; otherwise he proceeds to phase 2.

events.name: Ranch
events.desc_en: At the end of his phase 1, each player may discard any number of cards from his hand once to draw an equal number of cards from the deck.

events.name: Ricochet
events.desc_en: Each player may play BANG! cards against cards in play in front of any player: that card is discarded unless the owner plays a Missed!

events.name: Russian Roulette
events.desc_en: When Russian Roulette enters play, starting from the Sheriff each player discards a Missed!, until one player does not: he loses 2 life points and the Roulette stops.

events.name: Vendetta
events.desc_en: At the end of his turn, each player may Draw!: on a Heart, he plays another turn (but does not Draw! again).

symbol_grammar.MISSED_HAT: Cancel the effect of 1 BANG! card
symbol_grammar.LIFE_BULLET: +1 Life Point (cannot exceed max HP; no effect with only 2 players left)
symbol_grammar.ALL_PLAYERS_HAT_RING: Affects all other players in play regardless of distance
symbol_grammar.ANY_PLAYER_HAT: Target any 1 other player regardless of distance
symbol_grammar.CROSSHAIR_1: Target 1 player at reachable distance <= 1 (modified by Scope/Binocular/Mustang/Hideout)
symbol_grammar.CROSSHAIR_2: Weapon with Range 2 (replaces current gun in play)
symbol_grammar.CROSSHAIR_3: Weapon with Range 3 (replaces current gun in play)
symbol_grammar.CROSSHAIR_4: Weapon with Range 4 (replaces current gun in play)
symbol_grammar.CROSSHAIR_5: Weapon with Range 5 (replaces current gun in play)
symbol_grammar.CROSSHAIR_GUN_RANGE: Target 1 player within your current weapon's reachable distance
symbol_grammar.DRAW_CARD_HAND: Draw 1 card (from the deck, or from target player's hand/in-play when paired with a player symbol)
symbol_grammar.DISCARD_CARD_X: Discard 1 card (as an extra cost when on the left of colon, or force target to discard when on the right)
symbol_grammar.DRAW_CHECK_EQUAL: Draw! check from the deck: effect triggers if the drawn card matches the required suit/rank
